title: 文件名识别尺寸与数量
lead: 尺寸与份数，从文件名里读出来。
summary: 中文、英文和混合命名可放进同一批任务；在排版前查看尺寸与本次数量。

chapters.title: 混合命名，一起识别。
body: 把中文、英文及中英混合命名的图稿放进同一文件夹，在多图排版中导入。图稿编号继续作为标识，不会直接当成尺寸或数量。
W8cm P2 表示图案宽 8 cm、本次 2 份，并保留原比例。打开识别设置与结果，逐项检查尺寸、数量、单尺寸方向和默认单位。

chapters.title: 确认参数，再排成一整版。
body: 演示中的三张图分别为宽 8 / 6 / 7 cm、数量 2 / 3 / 1，共排出 6 份。每张图采用各自识别的尺寸。
生成 TIFF 后，切换彩色与 W1 白墨预览。尺寸指图案本身，不包含另外添加的切割框与空白边距。

checks: 识别尺寸与订单一致
本次数量逐项确认
彩色与 W1 输出分别检查

en.title: Filename size and quantity recognition
en.lead: Read the size and quantity from the filename.
en.summary: Read print dimensions and quantities from Chinese, English, or mixed filenames, then review the values before layout.

chapters.title: Mixed filenames. One batch.
body: Import Chinese, English and mixed filenames together for multiple-image layout. Artwork numbers remain identifiers, rather than becoming a print size or quantity.

W8cm P2 means an 8 cm artwork width and 2 copies, with the original aspect ratio preserved. Review dimensions, quantities, the single-dimension direction and default unit in the recognition settings and results.

chapters.title: Review the values. Then build the layout.
body: The demonstration uses artwork widths of 8 / 6 / 7 cm and quantities of 2 / 3 / 1, producing 6 copies in total. Each design uses its own recognized size.
After exporting TIFF, inspect the color and W1 previews separately. Dimensions refer to the artwork itself, excluding added cutting frames and blank margins.

checks: Recognized dimensions match the order
Quantities are confirmed for each artwork
Color and W1 outputs are inspected separately

title: 切割框与独立定位缺口
lead: 上、下缺口。按需要各自开启。
summary: 上下缺口独立开启，示意图随参数实时变化；框线、缺口和新增空白不生成 W1 白墨。

chapters.title: 框线、距离与缺口，分别设置。
body: 在 DTF 工作流程中打开切割框设置，调整图案到框线的距离、缺口深度与框线宽度。图案尺寸与切割框尺寸分开理解。
顶部和底部缺口各有一个开关：矩形框、仅上缺口、仅下缺口或上下同时开启，都可按定位需要选择。改变开关或数值，示意图立即更新。

chapters.title: 对齐更清楚，白墨保持独立。
body: 点击应用，生成 TIFF。开启旋转时，框线和缺口随图案一起旋转；输出后检查边距与缺口方向。
彩色预览显示框线和缺口。W1 白墨只覆盖需要喷白墨的图案区域，框线、缺口及新增空白不喷白墨。

checks: 上下开关符合定位需要
距离、深度与线宽已确认
框线与空白区域没有 W1

en.title: Cutting frames and independent notches
en.lead: Top and bottom notches. Switch each one as needed.
en.summary: Control top and bottom notches independently, with a live settings diagram. Frame lines, notches and added blank areas receive no W1 white ink.

chapters.title: Set the frame, spacing and notches.
body: Open Cutting Frame in the DTF workflow to adjust artwork-to-frame spacing, notch depth and line width. Keep artwork dimensions separate from frame dimensions.
Separate switches let you choose a plain rectangle, a top notch, a bottom notch, or both. The diagram updates immediately when a switch or value changes.

chapters.title: Clear alignment. Separate white ink.
body: Apply the settings and generate TIFF. With rotation enabled, frames and notches rotate with the artwork. Inspect margins and notch direction after export.
The color preview shows the frame and notches. W1 covers only artwork areas that need white ink; frame lines, notches and added blank areas receive none.

checks: Top and bottom switches match the alignment needs
Spacing, depth and line width are confirmed
Frame lines and blank areas contain no W1

title: 多色面料白墨控制
lead: 换一种面料颜色。白墨也跟着调整。
summary: 按面料相近区域和其他图案区域分别控制白墨；同一图稿演示红色、绿色面料输出。

chapters.title: 选择面料颜色，分别设置白墨。
body: 选择 10 种预设面料颜色之一，也可以自定义颜色或从图稿取色。彩色图稿保留，面料颜色用于白墨计算。
接近面料颜色的区域与其他图案区域分别控制白墨。演示设置为 5% 与 50%；白墨量不等于彩色图像的透明度。

chapters.title: 比较输出，接着做台板套位。
body: 点击生成 DTG 图稿，通过 Photoshop 保存带有 W1 的 TIFF。分别查看彩色与白墨预览，再切换红色、绿色面料比较白墨覆盖。
换面料颜色后重新生成，图稿颜色保留，白墨按新面料重新计算。确认结果后，可直接送入 DTG 台板套位。

checks: 面料颜色与本次订单一致
两类区域的白墨量分别确认
W1 覆盖检查后再进入套位

en.title: White ink for multiple fabric colors
en.lead: Change the fabric color. Adjust the white ink with it.
en.summary: Set white ink separately for fabric-matching areas and the rest of the artwork. Compare red and green fabric settings with the same design.

chapters.title: Choose the fabric color. Set white ink separately.
body: Choose one of 10 fabric presets, enter a custom color, or pick a color from the artwork. The color artwork remains intact; fabric color guides the white-ink calculation.
Control white ink separately for fabric-matching areas and the rest of the artwork. The demonstration uses 5% and 50%; white-ink quantity is separate from color-image opacity.

chapters.title: Compare the output. Continue to DTG placement.
body: Generate DTG Artwork uses Photoshop to save TIFF with W1. Inspect color and white ink separately, then compare coverage using red and green fabric settings.
After changing the fabric color, generate again. Artwork colors remain while white ink is recalculated. Once checked, send the result directly to DTG platen placement.

checks: The fabric color matches the order
Both white-ink amounts are confirmed
W1 coverage is inspected before placement

title: DTG 台板套位
lead: 尺寸定好。图稿放到正确的位置。
summary: 设置台板尺寸，拖动、居中或输入位置；彩色与 W1 一起保存到套位 TIFF。

chapters.title: 真实台板尺寸，精确放置图稿。
body: 完成白墨制图后进入 DTG 套位，设置台板宽度与高度。按实际尺寸定位，保留图案原来的打印大小。
拖动左侧预览，位置数值随之更新；也可以输入水平与垂直位置、使用居中辅助线，或用方向键微调。按住 Shift 使用较大的移动步进。

chapters.title: 确认位置，把彩色与白墨一起输出。
body: 演示采用 20 × 25 cm 台板，距左 20 mm、距顶 30 mm。确认位置后导出套位 TIFF，同时保存套位记录。
检查彩色图稿与 W1 在台板画布上的位置。台板与衣服示意只用于对齐，不会打印进图稿。

checks: 台板宽高与设备一致
图稿位置及实际尺寸已确认
彩色与 W1 对齐且边界完整

en.title: DTG platen placement
en.lead: Set the size. Put the artwork in the right place.
en.summary: Set the platen size, then drag, center, or enter a precise position. Export both color artwork and W1 on the platen canvas.

chapters.title: Real platen dimensions. Precise artwork placement.
body: After preparing white ink, open DTG Placement and set platen width and height. Position the artwork at real dimensions while preserving its print size.
Drag in the left preview to update position values, enter horizontal and vertical offsets, use center guides, or fine-tune with arrow keys. Hold Shift for a larger step.

chapters.title: Confirm the position. Export color and white ink together.
body: The demonstration uses a 20 × 25 cm platen, with offsets of 20 mm from the left and 30 mm from the top. Export the placement TIFF and save the placement record.
Inspect the color artwork and W1 on the platen canvas. The platen and garment illustrations are alignment references and are not printed into the artwork.

checks: Platen dimensions match the equipment
Artwork position and print size are confirmed
Color and W1 align with complete boundaries
